meta.node_def_layout: [create_fn, f1, f2, params from +0xC..., child def pointers]
meta.execution: each enemy runs the tree of the state on top of its AI stack (obj+0x238) once per frame; update returns 0 = running, non-zero = finished; GotoState replaces the state, PushState pushes; SubState inlines another state tree

checks: aggro: leaves state 0x14B at dx<=100, not at 104 (IfPlayerWithin2 r2=10000 -> 100 px)
ChasePlayer 153/256: 0.5977 px/frame is the modal per-frame step
attack state 0x14E (MeleeAttack + Wait 18) lasts 41-47 frames; one hit object spawned on entry
shot state 0xF4 (Align, Wait 30, GunShot 16 f) lasts 50-51 f; bullet spawned 35 f after entry
aggro 72 px (IfPlayerWithin r2=5184; yes at 72, no at 76)
state 0x178 (RifleShot 32 f + Wait 90) lasts exactly 123 f, bullet 8 f after entry
MISMATCH: while AlignWithPlayer(153) runs the enemy moves 0.5 px/frame, so that node speed unit is unconfirmed
no aggro radius (MarkTime -> wander state immediately)
combo state 0x322: 6 MeleeAttacks (6 hit objects ~20 f apart) over 161 f
Dabura melee state 0x71 lasts 28-34 f; no aggro radius
Pui Pui runs the generic fighter tree (identical timings to Majin Fighter, aggro 100 px)

node_types.name: GotoState
node_types.semantics: replace the current AI state (enemy vfunc +0x68 -> 0x0800AA4A); returns 1

node_types.name: Chance
node_types.semantics: each frame: rand16 < p -> run child (p/65536 per frame)

node_types.name: Selector
node_types.semantics: each frame update children in order until one returns non-zero (then return 1); typically a list of guarded decorators = priority list

node_types.name: Sequence
node_types.semantics: run children one at a time in order; finished when the last child finishes

node_types.name: Succeed
node_types.semantics: returns 1 immediately (singleton 0x03002BD0)

node_types.name: SubState
node_types.semantics: run state <state>'s behaviour tree in place (a reusable sub-tree)

node_types.name: IfPlayerWithin
node_types.semantics: player centre within sqrt(r2) px (aggro radius)

node_types.name: IfPlayerFarther
node_types.semantics: player centre further than sqrt(r2) px

node_types.name: IfPlayerInMeleeRange
node_types.semantics: player attackable and player bbox touches the enemy bbox grown by ~3-6 px; turns the enemy (obj+0x10) toward the player on the dominant axis

node_types.name: Wait
node_types.semantics: do nothing for <frames> frames, then finish

node_types.name: ChasePlayer
node_types.semantics: path-find toward the player (0x0803BB00/0x0803BB48, re-path every 8 frames); stops (state 0, returns 0) within ~2 px; footstep sounds for some gfx ids

node_types.name: StandStill
node_types.semantics: switch to the idle anim/state 0 (singleton 0x03002BA8); returns 1

node_types.name: IfPlayerAttackingMe
node_types.semantics: player in an attack state (0x03001B50) and player bbox (+8 px) overlaps the enemy

node_types.name: MeleeAttack
node_types.semantics: punch/kick: anim 0..3 chosen from the gfx def (+0x64/+0x68/+0x6C); hit box in front built from attack data 0x086B8098 (melee, mult 0x400 = x1.0 of the enemy STR formula); finishes when the anim ends

node_types.name: AlignWithPlayer
node_types.semantics: strafe along one axis to line up with the player; returns 1 within 3 px

node_types.name: StepTowardPlayer
node_types.semantics: face the player and walk straight at it (walk anim state 1)

node_types.name: FacePlayer
node_types.semantics: sends event vt 0x0804AE70 {player} to the enemy (obj+0x18C) -> turn toward player; returns 1

node_types.name: IfPlayerWithin2
node_types.semantics: player within sqrt(r2) px (variant using bbox centres)

node_types.name: ParallelAll
node_types.semantics: update every child each frame; finished when all children have finished

node_types.name: RunMotionController
node_types.semantics: ticks the controller object at obj+0x22C forever (never finishes)

node_types.name: StepAwayFromPlayer
node_types.semantics: walk directly away from the player (keep distance / flee)

node_types.name: IfTimeInState
node_types.semantics: frames since obj+0x210 stamp (state entry / end of block) > frames

node_types.name: Block
node_types.semantics: guard pose (anim state 7) with obj+0x1C8=1 (blocking) while running; exit clears it and stamps obj+0x210

node_types.name: IfCooldownOver
node_types.semantics: now - obj+0x1E8 (set by MarkTime) > frames

node_types.name: MarkTime
node_types.semantics: obj+0x1E8 = frame counter (starts a cooldown)

node_types.name: IfInPlayerBeamLine
node_types.semantics: player faces the enemy, player state vfunc[0x1C] true (charging/firing) and the enemy is in a 240 px corridor (+-4 px) in front of the player -> used to dodge beams

node_types.name: SetCounter
node_types.semantics: obj+0x1E4 = n

node_types.name: Idle
node_types.semantics: returns 0 forever (singleton 0x03001AF4)

node_types.name: IfGlobalFlag
node_types.semantics: global [0x03002FE4] > 0 (arena/boss event flag)

node_types.name: IfCounterEq
node_types.semantics: obj+0x1E4 counter == n

node_types.name: Wander
node_types.semantics: walk in a random direction (0..3, table 0x08752EB4); each frame rand16 < turn_p picks a new direction

node_types.name: VampireSummon
node_types.semantics: if the pool [0x08759360] has room spawn data 0x086FD9D0 at the enemy centre (bats / minions, random 0x1000..0x1FFF param); exit restores the gfx anim; finishes immediately

node_types.name: IfPlayerInRoomZone
node_types.semantics: player inside the trigger region of global object [0x087593C8]+0x80 (vampire lair)

node_types.name: VampireSummon2
node_types.semantics: like VampireSummon with pool [0x08759320]

node_types.name: KiBlast
node_types.semantics: controller 0x03003068: anim state 3; frame 16 fires projectile 0x08019858 (3 px/frame, dir table 0x08719C40); frame 32 back to idle

node_types.name: GhostAnimA
node_types.semantics: ghosts: anim 0x12 then a gfx-specific one-shot anim (0x60->0x5E, 0xDC->0xDB, 0xE5->0xE4) -- vanish/appear

node_types.name: IfAxisAligned
node_types.semantics: player attackable (+0x1CC) and |dx| < 16 or |dy| < 16 px (lined up for a shot)

node_types.name: IfHpBelow
node_types.semantics: on enter threshold = frac*maxHP>>16; true while HP (obj+0x28C) < threshold

node_types.name: SoldierThrow
node_types.semantics: face player; controller 0x03002FCC: anim 0x13, spawns projectile data 0x0874CA6C (frame thresholds 2/8/32)

node_types.name: FlyToPlayer
node_types.semantics: vampires: normalised move toward the player ignoring walls (same maths as WalkToPlayer)

node_types.name: IncCounter
node_types.semantics: obj+0x1E4 += 1; returns 1

node_types.name: SpawnPuff
node_types.semantics: enter: one-shot visual effect at the enemy centre (0x0800F924, flag obj+0x291); returns 1

node_types.name: IfPlayerInFront
node_types.semantics: player attackable and inside a box in front of the enemy (sets facing)

node_types.name: PushState
node_types.semantics: push AI state <state> on the enemy AI stack (vfunc +0x6C); returns 0

node_types.name: GhostAnimB
node_types.semantics: ghosts: counterpart of GhostAnimA

node_types.name: WalkToPlayer
node_types.semantics: Spopovich: straight-line move toward the player at speed (normalised vector, collision checked); faces the player on the dominant axis; finished within 8 px

node_types.name: IfPlayerInZone
node_types.semantics: player bbox inside the area rectangle at [[0x0876BA3C]+0x18] (sniper zone)

node_types.name: GunShot
node_types.semantics: face player; controller 0x03002FC4: anim 0x12, frame 4 spawns a bullet (data 0x0874CA38, builder 0x080274B4, sound 0x083193F8) if the pool has room; frame 16 back to idle

node_types.name: ParallelAny
node_types.semantics: update every child each frame; finished as soon as any child finishes

node_types.name: RifleShot
node_types.semantics: face player; controller 0x03002FD8: anim 0x12, frame 8 spawns a bullet (data 0x0874CA9C); frame 32 back to idle
